supportPage.seoDescription: Help for the Alpiplan app: contact, common questions and notes for teams.
supportPage.intro: Alpiplan is operated by {provider}. Here you’ll find who to contact and answers to typical questions about the app and the web.
supportPage.contactLead: For technical problems, bug reports or questions about running the platform:
supportPage.contactDetails: Please include if you can: device (iPhone, Android, browser), app version, tenant (organisation) and a short description, with screenshots if they help.
supportPage.accessLead: Alpiplan is usually provided through your organisation (ski school, team). Login details, roles and tenant access are issued by your organisation’s administrator — not by the app provider.
supportPage.accessPassword: Forgot password → on the sign-in page choose “Forgot password?” or ask your organisation’s administrator for a password link
supportPage.accessTenant: No tenant visible → ask an administrator for an invitation
supportPage.accessOrg: New organisation / contract → through your team contact or {email}
supportPage.pushSettings: In the app’s Settings, turn push on and grant permission
supportPage.pushIos: iOS: check System Settings → Notifications → Alpiplan
supportPage.pushWeb: Web: allow browser notifications; on iPhone this often requires “Add to Home Screen”
supportPage.pushMissing: If notifications still don’t arrive, write to us with the device type and the time of a missing alert.
supportPage.privacyRest: Privacy requests about customer or appointment data should go first to your organisation; the provider helps tenants with technical requests.

privacyPage.seoDescription: Information on the processing of personal data in the Alpiplan app and on the web.
privacyPage.title: Privacy policy
privacyPage.intro: This notice describes how the operator of Alpiplan (“we”) processes personal data when you use the Alpiplan web app or mobile apps. It supplements the privacy information of your organisation (tenant) where that organisation is the controller for customer and instructor data.
privacyPage.s1body: Controller for the processing described in this notice that we carry out as the software provider:
privacyPage.s2tenant: Tenant (for example a ski school): controller for the data processed in its account (instructors, customers, appointments, notes).
privacyPage.s2operator: Alpiplan operator: usually a processor for the tenant, where we store this data in the cloud and provide it technically.
privacyPage.s2users: Users: data subjects with rights of access, rectification, erasure, restriction, objection and data portability — for tenant-managed data they should contact their organisation first; we help the tenant fulfil technical requests.
privacyPage.s31a: Sign-in data (email, password hash), name, language, roles and tenant membership
privacyPage.s31b: Appointments, availability, customer and contact details, notes, payment status
privacyPage.s31purposes: Purposes: providing planning and capture features, authentication, tenant separation, support, security and stability.
privacyPage.s31legal: Legal bases: Art. 6 (1) (b) GDPR (contract / use on behalf of the tenant), (f) (legitimate interest in secure operation), and where relevant (a) (consent for optional features).
privacyPage.s32body: If you turn on push notifications, we store a device or push token so we can tell you about appointments. Legal basis: consent (Art. 6 (1) (a) GDPR), which you can withdraw in the device or app settings.
privacyPage.s33contacts: Contacts: read/write only after an OS permission and your action (for example saving a contact); the app works without the address book.
privacyPage.s33speech: Voice input: preferably on-device via operating-system APIs; audio is not stored permanently on our servers unless you separately turn on cloud transcription.
privacyPage.s33calls: Android call hints (optional): off by default; if you opt in, Alpiplan is set as the caller ID app and remembers the phone numbers of recent calls on the device only. The device call log is not read, and no call data is sent to our servers.
privacyPage.s4body: The application runs on servers in the EU or EEA (the exact location and sub-processors are listed in the data processing agreement with your tenant). Push services may involve providers such as Apple (APNs) or Google (FCM).
privacyPage.s5body: We keep personal data for as long as your tenant account is active and statutory retention duties apply. Deleted entries may first sit in the trash or as a soft delete; final deletion or anonymisation follows documented periods or a justified request from the tenant.
privacyPage.s6lead: You have the following rights towards the controller, among others:
privacyPage.s6a: Access, rectification, erasure, restriction of processing
privacyPage.s6c: Objection to processing based on legitimate interests
privacyPage.s6d: Withdrawal of consent with effect for the future
privacyPage.s6e: Complaint to a data protection authority
privacyPage.s6contact: For data your organisation processes as a tenant, please contact them first. For requests to us as the provider, use the email address above.
privacyPage.s7body: We use technical and organisational measures (including encryption in transit, tenant separation and access controls). Details are described in the TOM documentation for data processing.
privacyPage.s8body: We update this notice when the law or product features change. The current version is available at this URL.
privacyPage.disclaimer: Note: this page is not individual legal advice. Before production use, the text should be reviewed by qualified counsel or a data protection officer.
